description: Notices to mariners (Israel) is a data set listed in data.gov.il, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Transport and Road Safety. Coverage: Israel. Its title on the portal is "הודעות למשיטים" (Hebrew). The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Transport and Road Safety. Its tags are משיטים וימאים, משרד התחבורה, ספנות ונמלים, תחבורה. The portal shows 2023-03-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-il-portal.
